data.name: Valentino
data.gender_notes: Valentino is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Roman family name Valentinus, derived from valere 'to be strong'. In early Christian history, St. Valentinus was a popular name for martyrs. The name Valentino carries the meaning “Strong, Healthy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Valentino usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, healthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of strength and faith in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Valentino belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Healthy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Valentino total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_greek.name: Βαλεντίνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βαλεντίνο προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Valentius, που σημαίνει 'ισχυρός και υγιής'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα αυτό, αλλά η παράδοση του ονόματος συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Βαλεντίνο, που ήταν Χριστιανός ιερέας και μάρτυς.

data.cultural_impact: The name Valentino gained significant popularity in Western cultures due to St. Valentinus, a third-century Roman priest who was martyred for marrying couples and helping Christians during Claudius II's persecution. Today, the name is synonymous with romance and love, as we celebrate St. Valentinus on February 14th, known as Valentine's Day. The name personifies the strong and enduring bond of love and affection.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Valentino holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the martyrdom and selfless sacrifice of St. Valentinus. He embodies the virtues of love, courage, and sacrifice, inspiring generations to strive for positive change and righteousness. His legacy continues to inspire newlyweds to honor their commitment to one another with the profound tradition of marriage.
